setup.text: A hunter claims a red-eyed creature watches from the forest canopy at dusk.

a1.text: The hunter finds marks made by an ordinary animal.

b1.text: Observers see reflected eyes but cannot identify the creature.

c1.text: The legend becomes a warning against careless nighttime travel.

c2.text: The hunter feels dismissed and refuses to discuss the sighting.

a2__fx.text: The hunter vanishes overnight and returns shaken, unable to explain what happened.
